settings.hp_tuning_method: nested CV (inner LORO on train runs)

LDA.description: Linear Discriminant Analysis with shrinkage. Finds linear projection maximizing between-class variance.

Ridge.description: Ridge regression predicting sin(hue) and cos(hue). L2 regularization controls overfitting.

KernelRidge.description: Kernel Ridge with RBF kernel. Non-linear extension of Ridge via kernel trick.

SVM.description: Support Vector Machine with RBF kernel. Non-linear decision boundaries in voxel space.

MLP.description: Multi-Layer Perceptron with ReLU activation, early stopping, and L2 regularization.

ForwardEncoding.description: Brouwer & Heeger 2009 forward encoding model. 6 idealized color channels, analytical solution.
